title: Institute of Health features
description: A tabbed feature showcase on the page grey: a centred two-line heading, then a 50/50 split. Left: a grey pill switcher (square arrow buttons around the tab name) and, centred vertically, the tab's statement, a short paragraph and a dark button. Right half: a column of four small thumbnails (inactive at 65%, the active one ringed) beside a tall 6px-radius picture. It plays through the tabs by itself; each change blurs the new text up 10px into place. Phones stack picture, switcher, then centred text.
notes: needs JavaScript for the tabs and autoplay (hydrate: visible)
autoplay stops once a tab is picked, and is off under reduced motion
